jobs.title: Product Manager
jobs.description:
tl;dr: Fresh off a $15M Series A led by Accel (total funding now $20M+), Agave is experiencing hockey-stick growth. We're hiring a hands-on, technical product leader to build new products on top of infrastructure that took us years to build and no one else has. You'll own the full arc from idea to shipped product to ARR, working across Product Analysts, Account Executives, and engineers to move fast, launch repeatedly, and grow revenue. Learn more about us here (link https://www.figma.com/slides/nlpdpvRj3iS2qbPXqkMQz0/Agave--Candidate-Pitch-Deck?node-id=5-610&t=jDDiUrnFNhn2TWMm-1).

You'll have a rare advantage most PMs never get: deep proprietary infrastructure already integrated with every major construction platform, and a built-in distribution channel of 500+ paying customers and a growing co-sell network with some of the largest names in the industry. What you build will get used, it will compound, and you'll do it more than once.

No construction experience needed, we'll teach you everything.




WHY JOIN US?

 - Early-stage, yet de-risked: we are a rare combo of being early stage (high upside) but lower risk (5XX+ paying customers, $Xm+ recurring revenue, hockey-stick growth). You get the benefits of an early stage startup without the risk you’ll have at almost any other startup. You’ll have a ton of impact, work directly with our customers, and get to work on interesting technical challenges you won’t see at bigger companies. Although we’re early stage, we’ve eliminated key strategic risks you’ll face at other startups. Like an unproven product, lack of market validation, lack of revenue, co-founder disputes. We’re all young and hungry. Our team is fully in-person, tenacious, and committed - most of us moved to SF from far away (Canada, SoCal, Texas, Virginia) specifically to build Agave from the ground up.

 - Team is technical, diverse, young: you'll work with a formidable team that's experienced and ambitious. Our cofounders have worked together for 10 years, first at a startup that Amazon acquired, then at Amazon, and now at Agave. You'll learn a ton while having outsized ownership. You’ll have a front-row seat to the good and bad of building a company from the ground up.

 - Huge opportunity without direct competition: startups are incredibly hard, so you want to join one that has a unique advantage. You don’t want to spend years of your life on a company in a saturated market with tons of competition. We’re seizing an opportunity that’s massive (Construction is the world’s third-largest industry) but also overlooked by most people in startup land. As a result, we have a multi-year head start against potential competitors, increasing our odds of success significantly. We’re also backed by world-class investors (Accel, YC) and Construction insiders (Procore and Autodesk executives, founders of the largest construction tech companies like PlanGrid).

 - A platform that compounds: After years of building and developing key partnerships in the industry, Agave has proprietary integrations with every major construction ERP and project management platform that would take any competitor years to replicate. That infrastructure is your foundation. Every product you build plugs into it, and into every product we've already launched. The platform compounds as the suite grows, which means your work doesn't just drive standalone ARR, it makes the whole product more valuable. And unlike most PMs who ship into a vacuum, you're shipping into an existing, growing customer base with co-sell channels into some of the largest companies in the construction industry.

 - Momentum is accelerating: our AI products are the fastest-growing part of the business, with a third of new deals now including one. Channel partnerships are fueling that growth too: we signed 8 new ones in the last month alone.


RESPONSIBILITIES

Agave has spent years building deep, proprietary integrations with the major construction ERP and project management platforms — infrastructure no one else has. Your job is to take each from idea to MVP to production to $1M+ ARR as fast as possible, then do it again.

 - Define what gets built. Some products will arrive partially specced; others will start as a blank page. Either way, you'll synthesize signals from customers, PAs, AEs, and the market to define what to build, why, and in what order.

 - Lead cross-functional execution. You'll work daily with PAs, engineers, and AEs to move fast, from requirements and scoping through QA, launch, and customer rollout.

 - Go deep on the customer. You'll work directly with construction companies to understand their workflows, uncover unmet needs, and shape products that solve real problems people will pay for.

 - Set and drive the roadmap. Prioritize ruthlessly across a portfolio of products. Know what's worth building now versus later, and make the case to the team.

 - Think in platforms, not features. Every product you ship should make the next one easier to sell and faster to build. You'll keep the compounding effect of our suite in mind in everything you design.


REQUIREMENTS

 - Hands-on: you'll be a full-time builder, not a manager. You must love operating in the messy weeds of nuanced systems, understanding their complexity and simplifying it for our customers. You will focus on product execution and delivery, less on strategy and market research.

 - Technical: no need to code, but you must have at least 1 year experience working closely with APIs, databases, SQL, Postman, and similar tools. The more, the better.

 - 2+ years experience in software: at least 2 years of full-time experience working for a software company in a data analyst, product, or other technical role. We’re open to exceptional new grads with substantive internships. We want someone hungry and has lots of room to grow, who's ready to roll-up their sleeves and operate in the trenches.

 - High ownership + conscientiousness: able to manage many threads at once without sacrificing quality.

 - Meticulous attention to detail: structured thinker who nerds-out on nuances, accounts for edge cases, and tests your work thoroughly before calling it done.

 - Clear + concise communication: oral and written, must love writing crisp docs for internal + external reference.

 - Uncanny ability to deliver results: get the job done consistently, doing any task needed to deliver on time.

 - Comfortable with customers: able to work with a wide range of customers, spanning software engineers at startups to CFOs at specialty contractors. Can onboard new customers, run demo meetings, negotiate timelines, and communicate clearly over Slack, Zoom, and email.

 - In-person: pumped to work in-person in SF 5 days per week.

 - Nice to have:
   
   - Experience interfacing with customers (e.g. running user interviews, demoing SaaS products).
   
   - Knowledge of basic accounting or the construction industry, since many of our use-cases relate to automating financial workflows.


WHAT’S THE DIFFERENCE BETWEEN OUR PRODUCT MANAGER (PM) AND PRODUCT ANALYST (PA) ROLES?

Product Analyst (PA)

 - Deep technical research on source systems, APIs, and data models

 - Writing internal and external documentation (runbooks, integration guides)

 - Debugging integration issues and unblocking customer launches

 - Translating customer requirements into engineering specs

Product Manager (PM)

 - Building out defined roadmaps for new products

 - Leading cross-functional planning across engineering and go-to-market

 - Owning the overall product development lifecycle

 - Working with customers and prospects upstream to shape new feature and product areas

 - Synthesizing market, customer, and partner signals into product direction

 - Driving alignment between the business and what gets built

 - Mentoring and coordinating across the broader product team


BENEFITS

 - Equity: competitive equity, so you share in the upside you're helping create.

 - Healthcare: we cover 90% of your healthcare costs with several plan options.

 - 401k: we match 100% of your contributions, up to 4% of annual salary.

 - Performance Bonuses: we offer annual performance bonuses when we hit company growth goals. For 2026, the bonus is 15% of your base salary or OTE. We've had these bonuses for the last 3 years, and expect to continue to have them in subsequent years.

 - Relocation: sizable relocation bonus for folks currently located outside of the Bay Area, and a bonus for anyone (even within the Bay Area) who moves within a 15-minute walk of our office.

 - Breakfast & Dinner, delivered: breakfast and dinner stipends through DoorDash. Plus a kitchen stocked with coffee, snacks, drinks, and more.

 - Gym: on-site gym with Peloton, squat rack, Tempo, Yoga setup, and more.

 - Visa: we sponsor Visas (H1B, TN, etc.) for candidates who are a good fit!

 - Commuter benefits: employees can make pre-tax contributions toward commuting costs, and we'll cover the full cost of a Muni pass for those using public transit.


IN-PERSON

 - We've built Agave in-person since day 1, and will maintain an in-person culture in San Francisco going forward. We form tighter bonds, build a stronger culture, and move faster since we're all working from one location.

 - Our office is at 101 New Montgomery Street, San Francisco, right near Salesforce Park, coffee shops & restaurants, and a bustling downtown. We believe building in-person is a huge strategic advantage, and we hope you’ll join us.


ABOUT THE INTERVIEW

At each stage, we decide and update you within 24hrs:

 1. Intro (15min.) [Virtual]: informal chat for you to learn more about the role. We'll ask for details on your past projects and what you're looking for next. We want to know that you meet our basic requirements and can speak about your work clearly. You’re welcome to ask lots of questions about whether working at Agave makes sense for you.

 2. Experience (30min.) [Virtual]: we'll dive into the details of your recent work experience, asking questions to learn about what you've done. Our goal is to ensure you've worked on sufficiently complex projects to confirm you'll be successful if you join us full-time. We'll also reserve 10min to answer any questions you have about Agave.

 3. Live Exercise (30 min.) [Virtual] : we’ll have you work through a brief exercise with a member of our team.

 4. On-site (60min. x 5, all 1:1 interviews) [In-Person in SF, we pay for the trip]: you'll interview with each co-founder and our lead product manager This will be a deeper dive into your experience, technical fluency, and overall fit. Each interview is 1hr, 45min for our questions and 15min for yours.

extra.compensation: $130K – $200K • Offers Equity • Offers Bonus • Sign-on bonus, company-based performance bonus

jobs.title: Product Analyst
jobs.description:
tl;dr Fresh off a $15M Series A led by Accel (total funding now $20M+), Agave is experiencing hockey-stick growth. We're hiring a sharp, semi-technical generalist to become a deep product expert. You'll work directly with engineers to spec, test, and ship product improvements — rolling up your sleeves in the weeds of complex integrations, edge cases, and real customer data. This role is about execution, not strategy. Learn more about us here (link https://www.figma.com/slides/nlpdpvRj3iS2qbPXqkMQz0/Agave--Candidate-Pitch-Deck?node-id=5-610&t=jDDiUrnFNhn2TWMm-1).




WHAT IS AGAVE?

We're building the financial ops platform for construction, a $12T global industry run by software built 20-40 years ago, much of it on-prem with no APIs and no documentation.

We spent 3 years building the rails to read and write across those systems, and we use them to deploy AI for invoicing, expenses, compliance, billing, and more.

We have 550+ customers and our AI products are the fastest-growing part of the business: a third of new deals now include one, and we signed 8 new channel partnerships in the last month alone. We're backed by Accel and Y Combinator, with investors from Procore, Autodesk, and Plaid. Our three co-founders have worked together for 12+ years, across Graphiq (acquired by Amazon in 2017) and Amazon.

We’ve built something people actually need, in a market most of Silicon Valley ignores — which is exactly why we’re winning. The only thing slowing us down is hiring. Our team is small, scrappy, and high-caliber, and we’re looking for the next wave of builders who will help take Agave from breakout startup to category-defining company.




WHY ARE WE HIRING THIS ROLE?

We're growing fast, and our product surface is expanding rapidly. As we scale integrations and add new features, we need someone who can be the bridge between our engineering team and the messy reality of how customers actually use our product.

This person will own the investigative, speccing, QA, and rollout work that keeps our product moving quickly without sacrificing quality. You'll be embedded with engineers and will develop deep expertise in the systems we integrate with.




RESPONSIBILITIES

Product Investigation & Spec

 - Become a deep expert on every system we integrate with — ERPs, field tools, accounting platforms

 - Investigate edge cases and unexpected behaviors in our integrations through structured debugging

 - Write precise, engineer-ready specs for new features, improvements, and bug fixes

 - Own the full lifecycle of features from discovery through QA and rollout

QA & Rollout

 - Design and execute thorough test plans before features ship

 - Catch edge cases that engineers and customers would miss

 - Document rollout steps and own post-launch monitoring

Customer & Internal Feedback Loops

 - Synthesize feedback from customer calls, support tickets, and onboarding observations

 - Translate implicit and explicit product pain points into actionable specs

 - Partner with the AM/onboarding team to identify friction points and prioritize fixes

Process & Documentation

 - Build internal documentation for integration behaviors, known edge cases, and common configurations

 - Create and maintain testing frameworks that scale as our product grows

 - Identify and improve gaps in our product development process


WHAT WE LOOK FOR

 - Must have:
   
   - Hands-on: you'll be a full-time builder, not a manager. You must love operating in the messy weeds of nuanced systems, understanding their complexity and simplifying it for our customers. You will focus on product execution and delivery, less on strategy and market research.
   
   - Semi-technical: no need to code, but you must have at least internship experience working closely with APIs, databases, SQL, Postman, and similar tools OR excitement to learn. The more, the better.
   
   - Meticulous attention to detail: structured thinker who nerds-out on nuances, accounts for edge cases, and tests your work thoroughly before calling it done.
   
   - In-person: pumped to work in-person in SF 5 days per week.

 - Nice to have:

 - Experience building software products alongside software engineers and shipping products on tight timelines.


THIS ROLE MAY BE A GREAT FIT IF….

 - You aren’t a developer, but you’ve built side projects/hustles. You will get more of a chance to flex your technical acumen here than in most product roles, often working side-by-side with engineers.

 - You like tinkering. The systems we integrate with are old, challenging, and sometimes unpredictable. If you enjoy discovering through trial and error in a sandbox, you’ll fit right in.

 - You’re good at puzzles, complex turn-based games, etc - Construction project financials are a large dependency stack with many variables. If you manage complex systems well, you’ll likely pick it up quickly.

 - You want to learn how software products get built. You will work with an extremely high-performing team that knows how to build great technology and products.


THIS ROLE MAY NOT BE FOR YOU IF...

 - You want to be a product strategist or “CEO of the Product”. This role is about execution. Expect ~80% of your time spent on technical investigation, feature specs, QA, and rollout. If you want to own a roadmap and run discovery sprints, this isn't the right fit right now.

 - You prefer narrow, well-defined responsibilities. The scope here will evolve as we grow. You'll wear many hats and figure things out with limited direction.

 - You want a slow ramp. In your first week, you'll produce research docs that are ready for engineering to implement. We’ll expect you to quickly become an expert on the systems we integrate with, and every inch of our products. Naturally, this gives you outsized potential for growth.

 - You want a primarily customer-facing role. While you will interface with customers, this role will primarily focus on working internally with our product and dev teams.

 - You prefer remote work. We're in-person in San Francisco 5 days/week


BENEFITS

 - Equity: competitive equity, so you share in the upside you're helping create.

 - Healthcare: we cover 90% of your healthcare costs with several plan options.

 - 401k: we match 100% of your contributions, up to 4% of annual salary.

 - Performance Bonuses: we offer annual performance bonuses when we hit company growth goals. For 2026, the bonus is 15% of your base salary or OTE. We've had these bonuses for the last 3 years, and expect to continue to have them in subsequent years.

 - Relocation: sizable relocation bonus for folks currently located outside of the Bay Area, and a bonus for anyone (even within the Bay Area) who moves within a 15-minute walk of our office.

 - Breakfast & Dinner, delivered: breakfast and dinner stipends through DoorDash. Plus a kitchen stocked with coffee, snacks, drinks, and more.

 - Gym: on-site gym with Peloton, squat rack, Tempo, Yoga setup, and more.

 - Visa: we sponsor Visas (H1B, TN, etc.) for candidates who are a good fit!

 - Commuter benefits: employees can make pre-tax contributions toward commuting costs, and we'll cover the full cost of a Muni pass for those using public transit.


IN-PERSON

 - We've built Agave in-person since day 1, and will maintain an in-person culture in San Francisco going forward. We form tighter bonds, build a stronger culture, and move faster since we're all working from one location.

 - Our office is at 101 New Montgomery Street, San Francisco, right near Salesforce Park, coffee shops & restaurants, and a bustling downtown. We believe building in-person is a huge strategic advantage, and we hope you’ll join us.


ABOUT THE INTERVIEW PROCESS

 1. Intro (15min): informal chat for you to learn more about the role. We'll ask for details on your past projects and what you're looking for next. We want to know that you meet our basic requirements and can speak about your work clearly. You’re welcome to ask lots of questions about whether working at Agave makes sense for you.

 2. Writing Exercise (45min): we provide two short prompts that you reply to in a Google Doc. Our goal is to quickly decide whether you understand our business and can write clearly, with minimum time required from you.

 3. Experience (30min): we'll dive into the details of your recent work experience, asking questions to learn about what you've done. Our goal is to ensure you've worked on sufficiently complex projects to confirm you'll be successful if you join us full-time. We'll also reserve time to answer any questions you have about Agave.

 4. Case Study: longer form, written exercise that will assess your ability to succeed in the role.

 5. On-site (60min x 5, all 1:1 interviews) [In-Person in SF, we pay for the trip]: you'll interview with each co-founder and other members of our team. This will be a deeper dive into your experience and overall fit. Each interview is about 1hr, 45min for our questions and 15min for yours.

extra.compensation: $100K – $150K • Offers Equity • Offers Bonus • Sign-on bonus, company-based performance bonuss
